messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Stan video
parts:
Ehsan:

Thanks for sharing. That's a really nice tutorial. I can't
believe how much you packed into 6 minutes while maintaining
what feels like a calm pace. You should've
been doing my practical session at the Machine Learning
Summer School --- I'd like to see what you could
do with an hour!

We need to put up a list of videos somewhere.
I propose we add a new page and nav link on the
web site for tutorials. It'd start with:

* Ehsan Karim's video (link below)
* Shravan Vashishth's tutorial for psychologists
* my MLSS lectures (not available online yet)
* Andrew's appendix to BDA, available free online
* link to Kruschke's book (there's a chapter)

I created an issue so I wouldn't forget:

https://github.com/stan-dev/webpages/issues/8

- Bob
